rationale:
The subject, `ValidationContext.read_source`, requires three things. It must resolve an outline item to its graph node. It must read the contents. It must record the observation as described in the cited `read_source.inputs`. The marked test `direct_source_reads_preserve_mapping_errors_and_record_only_successful_returns` in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs` covers each of these. I did not request the implementation source, because the test source was enough to judge it.

- **Resolving to a node:**
  - A successful read of the supported address (`source.txt` with an empty selector) returns the prepared contents.
  - The test asserts that the recorded dependency is `Dependency::Node("source-node", returned.fingerprint())`.
  - It also asserts that `read_nodes` is `["source-node", "source-node"]`, which shows the item was mapped to the expected graph node.
- **Mapping failures:**
  - An unknown file and an unknown item selector each return an "unsupported source item" error.
  - Each failure leaves `dependencies()` empty.
  - Each failure leaves `reads` at 0 and `read_nodes` empty, so nothing is read when mapping fails.
- **Read failure:** With `fail_read` set, the error surfaces ("prepared source read failed") and no dependency is recorded. This covers the "Failures record no successful observation" clause of `read_source.inputs`.
- **Recording on success:** The dependency carries the node identity and the fingerprint of the returned contents. After the error cases, the test asserts exactly one dependency. The read count of 2 counts the failed read attempt and the successful one.
- **Staleness:** The test finishes the context into a record, checks that `is_current` is true, then changes the node's text and checks that it is false. This covers "The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes."

The agent-delivery clause of `read_source.inputs` ("agent reads record when delivering them") belongs to the separate tool-session paths. Those paths carry their own `read_source.inputs` tests in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs`, and they are not part of this subject's direct method. The `public_api.rs` test only checks that the export exists, which is acceptable as a supplementary marking.

I found no obligation of the subject that lacks a test or an assertion.

text: Resolve an outline item to its graph node, read the contents, and record the observation under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_source.inputs`.
impl<D: Domain> ValidationContext<'_, D> where D::Error: From<SourceError> {
pub fn read_source(&self, item: &OutlineId) -> Result<D::NodeContent, D::Error>;
A successful source read records the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint
record when returning the contents; agent reads record when delivering them.
The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes. The source
mapping cannot return an untracked successful read. Calling the standalone
outline parser directly records no graph dependency; a tracked node read must
enclose its use when its contents contribute to an assessment.
